title: F10 · ordinary · What If I Am Ordinary
lines: What if you are not special?
Not the topper. Not the star. Just a boy in the middle of the list.
Everyone online seems to be the best at something.
He went to the roof to be nobody for a while.
And he noticed, for the first time, a small white calf by the water tank.
Just sitting. Looking at one thing.
It did not do anything impressive.
It simply did not look away.
And for ten minutes, he did one thing: he breathed.
You do not have to be extraordinary. You have to be steady. That is sadhana.
